3899-5319-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
3899-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

6495-6972-7153.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7153.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.

2525-3763-5231-6749.description:

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Body Double.
When Body Double dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Paleoloth triggers, returning Body Double from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Umori.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5933-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1651-2073-6757-6797--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-6757-6797--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

1029-3043-5028.description:

Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-3043-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

565-610-3803-4423-6204.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
565-610-3803-4423-6204.description:
Cast Dream's Grip by paying {U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Orvar and Archmage Emeritus trigger.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Aquitect's Will from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Archmage Emeritus trigger, drawing Aquitect's Will from the top of your library.
Resolve Dream's Grip, untapping Mystic Sanctuary.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Aquitect's Will by paying {U}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Orvar and Archmage Emeritus trigger.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Dream's Grip from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Archmage Emeritus trigger, drawing Dream's Grip from the top of your library.
Resolve Aquitect's Will, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1651-2265-3715-5365.description:

2792-3489-4623.notablePrerequisites:
Mist-Syndicate Naga does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
2792-3489-4623.description:
Declare Mist-Syndicate Naga as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Mist-Syndicate Naga from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mist-Syndicate Naga's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mist-Syndicate Naga onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1849-2463-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1336-2011-3851.manaNeeded: {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, plus two additional mana in any two colors
1336-2011-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Heronblade Elite.
You have three opponents.
Najeela and Heronblade Elite do not have summoning sickness.
1336-2011-3851.description:
Declare Najeela and Heronblade Elite as attackers.
Najeela triggers twice, and Heronblade Elite's myriad ability triggers.
Resolve Najeela's abilities, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve Heronblade Elite's myriad ability, creating two token copies of Heronblade Elite that are tapped and attacking.
The nontoken Heronblade Elite triggers twice, and each token Heronblade Elite triggers once.
Resolve all Heronblade Elite triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the nontoken Heronblade Elite and one +1/+1 counter on each of the token Heronblade Elites.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures you control, giving them trample, lifelink, and haste until end of turn, and creating an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate the nontoken Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate a token Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate the other token Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures you control and creating an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 7, varying the colors of mana added in steps 8, 9, and 10 as needed to continue the loop.

2068-2178-4283.description:

Ashnod and Whisper trigger.
Resolve the Whisper trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Ashnod trigger, copying Whisper's ability, targeting another creature card in your graveyard.
Resolve both remaining Whisper abilities, returning two creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1017-1143-2445-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Diviner's Wand attached to Cryptic Trilobite.
1017-1143-2445-4929.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by paying {4}, causing you to draw a card.
Cryptic Trilobite and Wizard Class trigger.
Resolve the Cryptic Trilobite trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Wizard Class trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.

527-4896.description:

423-2309-3293.notablePrerequisites:
Fall of the Thran has exactly one lore counter on it.
You have at least four land cards in your graveyard, one of which must be a Plains.
You have a land card in hand.
You have a land drop available.
423-2309-3293.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Emeria Shepherd and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, choosing not to return a permanent.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Fall of the Thran triggers, causing each player to return two land cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
The two lands enter the battlefield, triggering Emeria Shepherd twice and Evolution Sage twice.
Resolve both Emeria Shepherd triggers,  choosing not to return a permanent.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, choosing not to proliferate.
Resolve the second Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Fall of the Thran triggers, causing each player to return two land cards from their graveyard to the battlefield, in which one of your returned lands must be a Plains, and sacrificing Fall of the Thran.
The two lands enter the battlefield, triggering Emeria Shepherd twice and Evolution Sage twice.
Holding priority, activate all available lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}.
Resolve the first Emeria Shepherd trigger,  choosing not to return a permanent.
Resolve the first Evolution Sage trigger, choosing not to proliferate.
Resolve the second Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Fall of the Thran from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Fall of the Thran enters the battlefield with a lore counter, destroying all lands.
Resolve the second Evolution Sage trigger, putting a lore counter on Fall of the Thran.
Repeat from step 5.

802-1235-2649-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to four lands that can produce {1}{W/U}{R}{R}.
802-1235-2649-3821.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Twinflame from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Peregrine Drake mutated creature.
The token Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Twinflame from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Resolve a second trigger from step 7, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 7, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 7 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 6, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature token.
